thread:
maya: kick off release-2026-03-23c for runtime-proxy v3.4.0. main change: model-route v4 + kv-cache LRU. rollout = gradual attenuation with regional fallback.

deploy-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-23c runtime-proxy v3.4.0 - started by maya

maya: rollout plan (TL;DR): set flag ff.proxy.route_v4 shadow -> 3% -> 25% -> 100% (2m soaks). gates: p95 <= +140ms, errors <= +0.5% abs. regional drain if region breach > 90s. full rollback if global errors > +0.9% for 1m.

owen: I'll own telemetry and manual rollback. setting up route heatmap and p95 alert filters.

tara: infra prep: pin old binary in eu-west and ap-south for 1h post-promote so we can revert fast. running pin now:
```
ssh infra@ops-eu "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-proxy v3.3.8 --pools=eu-west,ap-south --ttl=1h"
```

deploy-bot: deployment step complete: containers ready, canary checks passed.

maya: enabling ff.proxy.route_v4 -> 3%: `flags set ff.proxy.route_v4 3 --release=release-2026-03-23c`

owen: 3% soak: p95 +10ms, no error uptick. cache warmup logs look normal.

maya: moving to 25% now. `flags set ff.proxy.route_v4 25`

owen: 40s into 25% soak: eu-west p95 spiked +210ms and some 500s. applying regional drain to eu-west only to contain.

tara: setting eu-west to 0% and leaving pin active:
`flags set ff.proxy.route_v4 --region=eu-west 0`

release-bot: regional flag update: eu-west ff.proxy.route_v4 -> 0%

owen: eu-west p95 fell back to baseline after drain. global p95 within gate. proceeding to promote to 100% outside eu-west.

maya: `flags set ff.proxy.route_v4 100 --exclude-region=eu-west`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.proxy.route_v4 -> 100% (eu-west excluded)

tara: left old binary pinned in eu-west for 2h as a safety TTL. unpin plan: `runtimectl unpin runtime-proxy --pool=eu-west` after warmup window tomorrow.

maya: release note draft: "runtime-proxy v3.4.0 rolled out via gradual attenuation. eu-west kept on previous version due to regional tail latency; regional attenuation and pin applied. no widespread customer impact."

owen: opened PD ticket INC-2026-358 (minor) for triage + follow-up.

maya: thanks all  will paste notes into GH release and support blurb. thread will be closed after unpin. shipit. :shipit:
